753:t_200:6.en:
$$キリコ$$
「You're no different from $$ワイズマン#pilot$$ or $$ペールゼン$$.」

753:t_200:7.en:
$$キリコ$$
「Let me tell you, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$. Neither I nor any of us will be ruled by anyone.」

753:t_200:8.en:
$$キリコ$$
「Even if you are a god.」

753:t_201:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Poor $$テイタニア$$, living for unrequited love... Let me put an end to your suffering.」

753:t_201:1.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「Creeping into the gaps in the heart, whispering sweet words... Those who pose as gods use the same tricks everywhere.」

753:t_201:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Only your ignorance would make you think I am the same as the likes of $$ワイズマン#pilot$$.」

753:t_201:3.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「A glib talker can't be trusted...! I'll face you the warrior's way!」

753:t_201:4.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「I'll end this, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! This world has no need for an arrogant god!」

753:t_202:0.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「One who poses as a god and rules over people... You are my enemy.」

753:t_202:1.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「That is not so, $$シャッコ$$. Know that you are meeting a true god right now.」

753:t_202:2.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「Denying all others and justifying only yourself... In the end, you are no different from $$ワイズマン#pilot$$.」

753:t_202:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Very well, hero of $$クエント$$. I will teach you that there are things you cannot surpass, even you who exiled the gifted.」

753:t_202:4.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「I'll take you on, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$!」

753:t_202:5.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「Spirits of the $$クエント$$ heroes! To protect this world, lend me your strength!!」

753:t_203:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Ignorance is frightening, $$桂$$. You have no idea what my existence means, as the final key to $$時空修復|lc$$.」

753:t_203:1.en:
$$桂$$
「Unless we do something about you, a mass of the force that seeks to vanish, that chance will never come!」

753:t_203:2.en:
$$オルソン$$
「First we'll clear away an obstacle like you, then we'll carry out our mission!」

753:t_203:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You think the likes of you can bear the fate of all the parallel worlds?」

753:t_203:4.en:
$$桂$$
「I won't take that from someone who can't muster even that much resolve, calls himself a god, and sits back to watch the universe perish!」

753:t_203:5.en:
$$モーム$$
「That's right, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! $$桂$$ has resolved to fight for all living things!」

753:t_203:6.en:
$$桂$$
「And one more! To see the woman I love again!」

753:t_203:8.en:
$$桂$$
「But that's what gives birth to infinite power.」

753:t_203:9.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Then I will annihilate you and erase what is called hope from this universe!」

753:t_203:10.en:
$$桂$$
「Bring it, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! That's far more human than your prim saintly mask!」

753:t_203:11.en:
$$桂$$
「I'll end this, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! We'll live on, beyond you!」

753:t_203:12.en:
$$桂$$
「To advance into the future beyond, together with the ones we love!!」

753:t_204:1.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I'm sorry, $$セツコ$$. Because of my error, the situation has changed.」

753:t_204:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「To take back the eternity $$アサキム$$ stole from me, I seek your $$スフィア$$.」

753:t_204:3.en:
$$セツコ$$
「If you say you will stop the collapse of the universe, I will help you too...」

753:t_204:4.en:
$$セツコ$$
「But you...! You only think about yourself!」

753:t_204:6.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「This entire universe existed only for me! All I have to do is think of it that way!」

753:t_204:7.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I finally got to hear your true words, and it's a shame they turned out to be nothing more than that...」

753:t_204:8.en:
$$セツコ$$
「But! In that case, I'll fight with everything I have! To protect our future from you!」

753:t_204:9.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Come, $$ハマリエル・ザ・スター$$! Offer your power to $$至高神Ｚ$$!!」

753:t_204:10.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I am $$セツコ・オハラ$$ of $$グローリー・スター$$...! My duty is to protect the peace and freedom of the citizens...!」

753:t_204:11.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Now I will show the right qualities! With this $$バルゴラ・グローリーＳ$$, by defeating you!!」

753:t_205:0.en:
$$ランド$$
「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$! I'll settle our ties and the universe's tomorrow, all right here!」

753:t_205:1.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Come, $$ウェルキエル・ザ・ヒート$$! To take back eternity, I will have you hand over your $$傷だらけの獅子$$!」

753:t_205:2.en:
$$ランド$$
「All right! I like that raw emotion a lot better than your usual smug pretty-boy act!」

753:t_205:4.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「...I'm no match for you, $$ランド$$.」

753:t_205:5.en:
$$メール$$
「Of course not! Darling is the best guy in the world... in the whole universe!」

753:t_205:6.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「But I too have the resolve and pride to call myself a god! I'll crush the likes of you head-on!」

753:t_205:7.en:
$$ランド$$
「You've got a long way to go, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! Don't think a guy who only thinks about himself when it counts can beat a repairman who works for the world and its people!」

753:t_205:8.en:
$$ランド$$
「Let's burn, $$ガンレオン$$! We hammer warped things back into shape! That's how $$ビーター・サービス$$ does it!!」

753:t_205:9.en:
$$メール$$
「Go, go, Darling! Go, go, $$ガンレオン$$!!」

753:t_205:10.en:
$$ランド$$
「It's me, $$メール$$, and you who'll do this! We're going to repair the future of the universe!!」

753:t_206:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Why do you reject me, $$クロウ$$? In the new world, there are no debts to torment you.」

753:t_206:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Wiping the slate clean on what I've done isn't my style.」

753:t_206:2.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Let me tell you, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$. By paying back 1 G, I win back 1 G's worth of freedom...」

753:t_206:3.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Paying off my debt is me moving toward the future...! If it gets wiped out, that's the same as my future being crushed!」

753:t_206:4.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Paying off debt is moving toward the future...!? I don't understand...!」

753:t_206:5.en:
$$クロウ$$
「A guy who calls himself a god not getting a simple principle like this, you crack me up.」

753:t_206:6.en:
$$クロウ$$
「In short, you're in the way, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! For me and the universe's future, you've got to vanish!」

753:t_206:7.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I won't let you, $$ズリエル・ジ・アンブレイカブル$$! I will take your $$揺れる天秤$$ and obtain eternity once more!」

753:t_206:8.en:
$$クロウ$$
「You fool, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! I'll show you that a moment of life's brilliance is worth far more than eternity!」

753:t_206:9.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Let's go, $$リ・ブラスタ$$! I'll pay off the remaining balance in one lump sum with the combat data of enemies who warp even causality!!」

753:t_207:0.en:
$n
「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$... So the time has finally come.」

753:t_207:1.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「There is no mercy for you who rejected me. You will vanish beyond causality.」

753:t_207:4.en:
$n
「Even if there was an ulterior motive, if it weren't for you, I would have died in the $$時獄戦役$$...」

753:t_207:6.en:
$n
「That's my line drawn! From here on is the real fight!」

753:t_207:8.en:
$n
「For Dad, Mom, and Sis! I'll avenge them! And to protect the lives and future of the entire universe, I'll defeat you!」

753:t_207:11.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Just as you followed your own heart, I will speak my honest feelings now.」

753:t_207:12.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$n... I'm glad I got to meet you, one who overcame hope and despair and became the $$太極$$ itself.」

753:t_207:13.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「For me, exiled from $$エス・テラン$$, that may have been the only thing I gained.」

753:t_207:14.en:
$n
「You're small, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! I'm not the only one who has overcome hope and despair!」

753:t_207:15.en:
$n
「Miss $$スズネ$$ and everyone in $c are the same! Everyone lives like that!」

753:t_207:16.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Let's go, $n! Protecting those lives is our fight!」

753:t_207:17.en:
$n
「Please... lend me your strength, Miss $$スズネ$$!」

753:t_207:19.en:
$n
「Let's go, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! I'll surpass you with everything we have!」
